create_repo_model: create a new model repository on the Hugging Face Hub with specified visibility and SDK settings
upload_file_model: upload a local file to a model repository on the Hugging Face Hub with automatic LFS handling
list_models_filter: list models on the Hugging Face Hub filtered by tag, author, or pipeline task
hf_hub_download: download a file from a Hugging Face Hub repository with caching and progress bar support
create_commit_files: create a commit with multiple file additions, deletions, and copies in a repository
